_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. LED indexes are 0-based from the POWER end of the strip. Ranges are [first, last] inclusive.
_max_pixels: The most pixels the strip takes in one realtime frame (a bigger frame is dropped). It follows the app's 'number of segments' setting: with the strip 'cut' at its real LED count it equals leds and every pixel is one LED; with a longer nominal length it is less and LEDs light in pairs. Find it with the pixel grid on the page.
_default_theme: Optional. What the engine restores when it stops while the applied theme is itself a realtime one ('RT: ...').

zones._help: Every zone is optional. An effect falls back to the whole strip when a zone it needs is missing. The theme builder offers each arch, runway, side and the door as a zone.

layout._help: Optional: where each run of LEDs sits on the canvas (pixels on a 1200x600 canvas). python layout.py turns this into govee_led_layout.json.
